meta.siteDescription: A home for Japanese language, culture, and community in Norwalk, California. Japanese school, judo, basketball, cultural events, and more.

footer.legal: Southeast Japanese School & Community Center. A nonprofit community organization.

home.heroTitle: A home for Japanese culture and community.
home.heroText: For generations, the Southeast Japanese School & Community Center has brought neighbors together through language, arts, sports, and celebration. Everyone is welcome.
home.missionText: To preserve and share Japanese language and culture, and to strengthen the bonds of community in Southeast Los Angeles County — across generations and backgrounds.
home.noEvents: New events are being planned — check back soon, or call the center at (562) 863-5996.
home.groupsText: The center is home to Japanese language school, judo, basketball, and cultural groups that meet here year-round.
home.supportText: Donations and dues keep our doors open for the next generation. Every gift, large or small, makes a difference.
home.connectText: Questions, ideas, or want to get involved? We'd love to hear from you.

groups.metaDescription: Japanese school, judo, basketball, and cultural groups that meet at the Southeast Japanese School & Community Center.
groups.title: Groups & Programs
groups.lede: The center is shared by independent groups and programs — from Japanese language school to judo and basketball. Reach out to a group directly to join, or contact the center to start a new one.
groups.empty: Group listings are coming soon. In the meantime, call the center at (562) 863-5996 to learn about Japanese school, judo, basketball, and other programs.
groups.useBefore: New clubs and classes are welcome. Contact the center at
groups.useAfter: or (562) 863-5996 to ask about facilities and scheduling.

payments.metaDescription: Donate to the Southeast Japanese School & Community Center or pay dues and tuition.
payments.title: Payments & Donations
payments.lede: Every payment method below sends 100% (or as close to it as possible) of your money to the center — we've chosen options with no processing fees wherever we can.
payments.donateText: Donations fund building upkeep, programs, and scholarships.
payments.donateSoonBefore: Until then, donations are gratefully accepted by Zelle or by check (see below), or contact the center at
payments.duesText: Participant dues, Japanese school tuition, registration, and textbooks can be paid two ways — both fee-free, so the center receives your full payment.
payments.zelleText: Send payments through your bank's app with Zelle — instant and no fees.
payments.zelleMemo: Please include the student or member name and what the payment is for in the memo.
payments.checkMemo: Include a note with the student or member name and what the payment covers.
payments.questionsBefore: Questions about tuition amounts or what you owe? Email
